_meta.R: C(P,6) * q(ticket): the model's predictive probability of the exact ticket over the uniform-draw probability; a model statement, not a realized evidence increment
_meta.inference: backtest summaries are DESCRIPTIVE: eight models over a chosen window, no multiplicity control, not a registered test; registered decisions are the registry E/M processes and the C4 terminal analysis
_meta.next_draw_note: each game is predicted from an independent copy of the post-history state, as if its draw were the next row; a draw of another game in between would update the models first
_meta.ticket: maximum-inclusion set law.top6() (six largest predictive inclusion probabilities; ties to the lower ball)

windows.exploratory: draws dated <= the registration date; the models were designed with them
windows.registered: draws dated after the registration date
